inventoryAgent.card1Text: The Professional Agent analyzes each computer and detects hardware such as processor, memory, disks and network without manual intervention.
inventoryAgent.card2Text: Automatically records installed programs, versions and operating systems for total control.
inventoryAgent.card3Text: Every change on the equipment syncs with our platform, keeping the inventory updated in real time.
inventoryAgent.card4Text: All collected information is centralized in your management platform to facilitate reports and decisions.
inventoryAgent.lead: Control, manage and analyze your IT inventory in real time with a centralized, modern and scalable solution.
inventoryAgent.installationText: We perform a preliminary analysis and handle help desk installation and configuration: we adjust workflows, migrate data, configure plugins and integrations (LDAP/AD), email templates, SLAs and roles, and validate the operation with the client.
inventoryAgent.backupText: We generate biweekly database backups, document the restoration process and deliver the backup files to the client for custody.
inventoryAgent.trainingText: We train your staff on the help desk: ticket management, roles, workflows, inventory administration and operational best practices.
inventoryAgent.demoText: We offer a free demo where we showcase ticket workflows, technician collaboration, report generation and how the system adapts to your processes.
inventoryAgent.agentInstallText: We assist with installation and deployment of the inventory agent across devices (batch installs supported), verifying scans and connectivity to the platform.
inventoryAgent.inventoryOrganizationText: We review and structure categories, locations, owners and policies for a consistent inventory, with recommendations for labeling and maintenance cycles.
inventoryAgent.mensajeFinal: Less manual work. More control over your IT infrastructure.

faqs.a1: It is a system that centralizes all technical support requests, allowing them to be organized, assigned and tracked efficiently.
faqs.q2: Does the platform work in the cloud?
faqs.a2: Yes, it can be implemented in the cloud or on local servers according to your company's needs.
faqs.a3: Yes. The platform allows you to register equipment, licenses, responsible parties, maintenance history and more.
faqs.a4: Of course. You can view metrics on response times, tickets attended and IT area performance.
faqs.subtitulo: Find quick answers about our platform, features and services.
faqs.q5: Do you offer support after implementation?
faqs.a5: Yes, we offer continuous support, technical assistance and improvements as your operation grows.
faqs.q6: Do you install the help desk?
faqs.a6: Yes. We install and configure the help desk, tailoring it to your processes, migrating data and validating the operation with the client.
faqs.q7: Do you create backups and help with inventory?
faqs.a7: We create periodic backups of the database, deliver the copies and help organize the asset inventory and responsible roles.

onboarding.titulo: How we work with your company
onboarding.step1Desc: We analyze your company, processes and architecture: network and device scans, workflow review and risk detection to design the best implementation.
onboarding.step2Desc: We run a free demo where we showcase ticket workflows, report generation and the inventory agent to validate how it fits your processes.
onboarding.step3Desc: We install the help desk and the inventory agent, configure access/keys and integrations (LDAP/AD), schedule biweekly backups and train your staff.
onboarding.footer: * We coordinate migration, testing and handover with support during rollout.

techDifferentiator.descripcion: Unlike traditional support that only shows up when something breaks, our **Professional Agent** ecosystem allows us to audit your company in real time, ensuring your operations never stop due to a foreseeable technical failure.
techDifferentiator.item1Desc: We monitor disk health, temperature and memory. If a device is going to fail, we know before the user does.
techDifferentiator.item2Desc: A complete clinical history of each device. Less diagnosis time, faster solutions.
techDifferentiator.item3Desc: We deliver obsolescence reports so your technology investment is smart and planned.
